description: The process workshop is how every JustAutomate engagement starts: the team maps how a process really runs, lists automation candidates with estimated hours saved, sets the implementation order and quotes the implementation. Returns the public price per week (net, excluding VAT), typical duration, deliverables and the offer page for each market: PL (Poland, PLN), DE (Germany), AT (Austria), CH (Switzerland, CHF), INTL (English-speaking clients, EUR). Implementation itself is quoted only after the workshop.
